category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: A resolved view of the whole setup
history.description: `ledger doctor` reports the setup as the tool actually resolves it, rather than as the settings files state it: where the project and its ledger are, how many features and releases exist, the full accent palette derived from the one brand colour, whether the front page will use a logo or a wordmark, whether the requested fonts are ones that can be embedded, whether a local style override is present, and which browser on this machine will print the edition.
history.dev_notes: src/commands/build.mjs — cmdDoctor. The browser line calls probeBrowser(), which launches and closes a Chromium, so it reports the real resolution order rather than a guess.
